history.summary: Shree Shirdi Saibaba Mandir is a prominent, centrally located Sai temple at 34 Sai Mandir Road, Sector 6, Bhilai (490006). It is one of the most-visited religious sites of the Durg-Bhilai twin city, drawing large evening crowds of Sai devotees. Traveler reviews describe a grand, peaceful complex with flower and puja vendors at the entrance and daily aartis. It is distinct from the Sai temple at Hudco, Durg run by the Shri Saibaba Sansthan Trust. Exact founding year and management details UNVERIFIED.

name: Shree Shirdi Saibaba Mandir
town_description: Bhilai is a major industrial city in Durg district, Chhattisgarh, best known for the Bhilai Steel Plant of SAIL, one of India's largest steel works. It forms a twin city with Durg, about 30 km west of Raipur. Sector 6 is a central residential sector of the Bhilai township.
